name: office-template-library
description: Office template library: DOCX template editor + PPTX template preview (monorepo)

scripts.bootstrap: node scripts/bootstrap-storage.mjs && pnpm --filter api db:deploy && pnpm --filter api db:seed
scripts.build: pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter api test && pnpm --filter api test:e2e
